青少年鼻咽血管纤维瘤：上颌骨摆动入路

Juvenile Nasopharyngeal Angiofibroma: Maxillary Swing Approach.

临床研究鼻科IF 2.3Q2

中文摘要

上颌骨摆动入路是治疗晚期青少年鼻咽血管纤维瘤（JNA）的一种非常有效的手术方法。它能够广泛暴露翼腭窝、颞下窝和颅底，从而完整切除具有相当局部延伸的病变。 本研究旨在评估上颌骨摆动技术治疗广泛性鼻咽血管纤维瘤的疗效和结局。本文介绍了一项关于上颌骨摆动入路治疗晚期JNA的临床表现、手术技术、结局和并发症的观察性研究。 共有11例接受上颌骨摆动入路治疗的患者纳入研究，其中6例分类为Radkowski IIIA期，5例为IIIB期。无围手术期死亡，所有患者术后均通过鼻内镜和影像学进行监测。 上颌骨摆动方法是一种经上颌入路的变体，能够更广泛地暴露鼻咽、翼腭窝和翼上颌裂。它为处理广泛性JNA提供了一条安全有效的途径，从而降低了并发症发生率和复发风险。

英文摘要

The maxillary swing approach is a very efficient surgical procedure for treating advanced-stage juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma (JNA). It allows wide access to the pterygopalatine fossa, infratemporal fossa, and skull base, allowing for the entire removal of malignancies with considerable local extension. The purpose of this study was to assess the efficacy and outcomes of the maxillary swing technique for the treatment of extensive nasopharyngeal angiofibroma. An observational study on the presenting features, surgical technique, outcomes, and complications of the maxillary swing approach in advanced-stage JNA is presented. A total of 11 patients treated with the maxillary swing approach were included in the study, with 6 classified as Radkowski stage IIIA and 5 as stage IIIB. There were no perioperative mortalities, and all patients were monitored postoperatively through nasal endoscopy and imaging. The maxillary swing method, a version of the trans-maxillary approach, allows for wider access to the nasopharynx, pterygopalatine fossa, and pterygomaxillary fissure. It provides a safe and effective route for approaching extensive JNAs, thereby reducing morbidity and the risk of recurrence.
